flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4103 then Open the booking form for a free first visit.
Enter the name Sam Rivera and the email sam@example.com, choose the visit date 2 November 2026 and the arrival time noon, accept the climbing waiver and confirm the booking.
Wait 5 seconds, then verify the text PL-4821 is still visible on the page.

summary:
Opened the free first-visit booking form.
Completed and confirmed a booking for Sam Rivera (sam@example.com) for 2 November 2026 at noon, with the climbing waiver accepted.
Waited 5 seconds after confirmation.
The confirmation page remained visible and showed reference PL-4821.
